feeds.title: All things paper
feeds.description: I'm Ann Martin, a quilling enthusiast who explores the worlds of creative paper art and paper craft. Topics range from the latest on the craft scene - stylish DIYs, trends, and book reviews - to interviews with established artists, and features about emerging artisans with big ideas. I hope you'll be inspired to look at paper in a new light.

feeds.title: P.S. Paper Crafts Blog
feeds.description: I've been paper crafting since the late '90s whenever I had free time. My very demanding, corporate job and raising 3 children left me with very little time for my passion.
